name: Efora Energy Limited
source: Yahoo Finance | JSEBLOCKED 17 Nov 2026: trading suspended 10 July 2025 after the audited statements for the year ended 28 February 2025 were not published, with a further delay announced on 31 July 2025. The quarterly update of August 2026 records that the board resolved in May 2026 to pursue provisional liquidation before continuing to examine recapitalisation alternatives, so no audited accounts for FY2025 have been issued. Verified at https://eforaenergy.com/quarterly-update-announcement-12/eel-quarterly-update-sens-august-2026-final

filerStatus.source: JSE SENS quarterly update announcement, Efora Energy Limited, 28 August 2026
filerStatus.note: Trading in the shares has been suspended since July 2025 following the late publication of the consolidated annual financial results for the year ended 28 February 2025. The 28 August 2026 quarterly update says the outcome of the potential transaction will inform the approach to publication of the 2025 annual results, so FY2025 remains unpublished and the statements stop at the last year filed.
filerStatus.reasonShort: trading suspended since July 2025 and the annual results for the year to 28 February 2025 are still unpublished, so the last filed year is shown.
